subject: Help Us Improve R-INLA – Please Fill Out Our Questionnaire

messages.author: fda1962767a2614c
messages.subject: Help Us Improve R-INLA – Please Fill Out Our Questionnaire
parts:
Dear INLA Enthusiasts,

In preparation for the upcoming INLA workshop at the end of May, we kindly invite you to complete a short questionnaire about your experience with the R-INLA package:

Link is here.

Our goal is to better understand how R-INLA is being used and how we can further improve it. The questionnaire should take no more than 10 minutes to complete, and all responses are collected anonymously.
If you know other regular INLA users who will not be attending the workshop, please feel free to forward the questionnaire to them as well.

We would appreciate it if you could submit your responses by May 13th, so we have enough time to review the results ahead of the workshop.

Thank you very much for your time and support — we look forward to seeing you soon!

Best regards,
Esmail
